ratio.description: The aspect ratio the frame holds its child to, applied as the `--x-frame-ratio` custom property. The behavior's own default is `16/9`. NOTE: this schema declares a default of `16x9`, which the code never produces — the two disagree and the code is authoritative.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
